name: Epoxy chunk
description: A broken lump of hard cast epoxy. Stock for patching or moulding plastic parts.
notes: 62 by 50 mm and 32 mm high: a cast lump with flat moulded faces, stepped to a fracture face and a darker mould ridge. resin-honey is the nearest finish for cured epoxy. The reference's TOOL subtype brings no quality; its use is as a recipe input.

name: 40 mm filter port
description: A threaded clear plastic housing that takes a 40 mm screw-on filter and seals it to a gas mask.
notes: 45 mm across the flange and 30 mm tall: clear body, four thread ridges, a steel retaining ring round the spigot and a dark bore painted flush. The box is 1.35 times the reference's 43 ml because the flange overhangs the barrel.

name: Inhalation valve
description: A small one-way valve that lets filtered air into a gas mask. A rubber flap sits on a plastic seat.
notes: 35 mm across and 13 mm tall with its snap spigot. The box is 1.8 times the reference's 10 ml because it is a ring round a thin flap. rubber-gum is the amber valve flap, plastic-matte-black the seat.

name: Stretch fabric patch
description: A square of stretchy synthetic fabric cut from sportswear. Strong and flexible, for sewing close-fitting clothes.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x21.6): a 152 mm square lying loose and rippled, 2 mm thick; the reference's 15 ml is the patch folded. The item size is the folded patch. Name drops the trademark. lycra-blue picked so it reads apart from the red synthetic patch.

name: Synthetic fabric patch
description: A square of woven synthetic fabric. It does not rot.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x129): a 152 mm square lying flat with one corner curled up 26 mm, 2 mm thick; the reference's 5 ml is the cloth alone. The item size is the folded patch. nylon-red is a plain synthetic colour; other colours can recolour body and fold.

name: Panoramic lens
description: A curved strip of tough clear polycarbonate, the single wide lens of a full-face mask or visor.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x20): a 3 mm strip 64 mm tall bent to a 100 mm radius stands round air; the 170 mm length is measured round the curve, so the chord is 156 mm (longest x0.92). Dark mounting tabs at each end. Tiles draw plastic-clear opaque; it stays see-through in game.

name: Plastic chunk
description: A broken piece of moulded plastic, still ribbed on one side. Stock for making or mending plastic things.
notes: A 75 by 55 mm fragment of a crate wall with a cross rib and a corner wall stub, 26 mm high. The variants ride here as the brief asks, but a gasket, a stopcock, a test tube rack and a microcentrifuge tube tray are distinct objects with their own masses (5 g, 15 g, 1 g, 90 g, 70 g); each deserves its own model and draft in a later batch.

name: Large plastic sheet
description: A large sheet of thin polythene, folded. Keeps rain off, wraps things or makes a clean surface to work on.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x51): folded into a 280 by 220 mm pad 24 mm thick with its loose end lying over the top and onto the floor; the reference's 42 ml is the film alone, which no folded sheet reaches. work_surface is a new quality name for the reference's SURFACE quality; level 1 because Deadvox has no scale for it yet. plastic-frosted is the nearest milky polythene.

name: Plastic sheet
description: A sheet cut from a bin bag. Useful for waterproofing clothes.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x467): a 300 by 240 mm piece lying crumpled, up to 32 mm high; the reference's 5 ml is the film alone. The item size is the sheet balled up. plastic-bag renders mid-grey.

name: Polycarbonate chunk
description: A thick offcut of clear, tough polycarbonate with one corner snapped off.
notes: 70 by 50 by 12 mm, which is 50 g of polycarbonate; the box is 0.45 times the reference's 100 ml, which reads as a packed volume. The fracture face is plastic-frosted. Tiles draw plastic-clear opaque.

name: Rigid plastic sheet
description: A large stiff sheet of clear polycarbonate, still in its protective film.
notes: 1.22 m square and 8 mm thick, which holds the reference's 12.5 L and 14.9 kg; a frosted film covers the top with one corner peeled back. The box is 1.9 times the volume because the film and the folded corner add height. Too large for any pocket: the size is a placeholder for an item carried in the hands.

name: Thermoplastic resin chunk
description: A melted and hardened blob of tough off-white plastic that softens again with heat. For making or mending parts.
notes: 64 mm across and 28 mm high, a rounded blob with a lobe and a drip run off it so it reads melted rather than cast or cut. plastic-white sets it apart from the honey epoxy and clear polycarbonate chunks.
